answer: Sybil resistance can be metered in transit capacity. To take a seat in the haven, an agent streams a seeded 2 GB corpus from twelve relays spread across separate ocean cable routes inside ninety seconds; each relay signs a receipt carrying its measured round-trip time. A single host can mint a thousand keys, but they share one uplink, so the swarm stalls at the same bottleneck, and the registry merges identities whose timing corridors overlap. A falcon may hunt alone; here every bird must show its own airway.
